## Protocol impact

- [ ] This change does not affect which operations are accepted or how a DID resolves.

If it does, it is a protocol change under the Archonomicon (see [GOVERNANCE.md](https://github.com/archetech/archon/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md)):

- [ ] The [did:cid specification](https://github.com/archetech/didcid-specs) describes it, with signed test vectors that every implementation passes (rule 45)
